CHALDEAN-PLANES-001.say: With your mental plane (4-9-2) missing, your intellect is good when young, but memory and retention can fade later in life.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-002.say: With your emotional plane (3-5-7) missing, you may feel lonely and be less emotional towards yourself and others.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-003.say: With your physical plane (8-1-6) missing, you may face losses, less success and luxury, and the failure of big plans.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-004.say: With your vision plane (4-3-8) missing, you may feel confused, without a clear goal or planning.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-005.say: With your will plane (9-5-1) missing, you may lack the desire to succeed, and think a lot but struggle to decide.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-006.say: With your action plane (2-7-6) missing, you may feel apathy and laziness, avoid risks and lack the energy to fight back.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-007.say: With your silver plane (2-5-8) missing, you may face frustration, obstacles everywhere, constant hustle and repeated failure.

CHALDEAN-PLANES-008.say: With your golden plane (4-5-6) missing, you may be suspicious, have trust issues and find it hard to work with others.
